title: Intermediate triangle diagram for pinned right-adjoint tensor comparison
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Choose the ambient and open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe, derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Assume Rf* preserves quasi-coherent objects (hRf), O_Y is quasi-coherent (hO), and Lf*K⊗E is quasi-coherent for quasi-coherent K,E (hTensor). Fix a monoidal pullback structure, a pullback adjunction a, a right adjoint c to the quasi-coherent restriction of Rf*, and its adjunction adj. Put F(K)=Lf*K⊗c(O_Y), lifted to the quasi-coherent full subcategory. Let τ:F→c be a natural transformation satisfying, at every K, the pinned projection-isomorphism and adjunction-mate component formulas of [lem-sc-right-adjoint-tensor-comparison-natural]. Write t_K for its underlying ambient morphism. (2) For each ambient distinguished triangle T and quasi-coherent A,B,C with T.obj₁≅A.obj, T.obj₂≅B.obj, T.obj₃≅C.obj, there exist distinguished triangles T₁,T₂ in D(O_Z), a triangle morphism m:T₁→T₂, and vertex isomorphisms eF_i:T₁.obj_i≅F(K_i).obj and ec_i:T₂.obj_i≅c(K_i).obj, where (K₁,K₂,K₃)=(A,B,C), such that m.hom_i=eF_i.hom≫t_(K_i)≫ec_i.inv for all three vertices. No invertibility of t_K, closure of its isomorphism locus, or preservation of coproducts is asserted.

proof.text: Prove integer shift stability of quasi-coherent cohomology by applying the shifted homology-functor comparison and transporting quasicoherence along the resulting sheaf isomorphism. Use the induced shifts on the full subcategory.

Apply the compatible exact structures theorem to the two ambient-valued comparison functors and the pinned transformation. Obtain their coherent shift structures, the compatibility of tau with shifts, and preservation of ambient distinguished triangles.

Transport the three arrows of T to A,B,C through the given vertex isomorphisms. On the third arrow use the shifted first isomorphism followed by the inverse shift comparison of the quasi-coherent inclusion. Triangle.isoMk supplies an isomorphism from T to the ambient image of the transported triangle S, so that image is distinguished.

Apply both functors to S. Their images are distinguished by the structure theorem. Make the triangle morphism using the components of tau at A,B,C: naturality proves the first two squares, and NatTrans.shift_app_comm followed by naturality proves the third. The mapped triangles have exactly the required vertices, so take the six identity vertex isomorphisms and simplify the three component formulas.
